title: 第十二章 难道是个宝贝第十三章 是你啊
content_zh:
第十二章【难道是个宝贝？】
陈言正在研究自家的院子，脚下踩着奇怪的步伐，口中念念有词，从奇门数法，到天罡地煞的数算，然后再到八卦方位。
“乾、坤、离、坎、震、巽、艮、兑……”
陈言在院子里游走，手里抱着个罗盘。
嗯，罗盘这个东西，是买来的，不是什么自己弄的法器。
某宝就有。
陈言手里的这个，包邮一百八十多。
商家是卖工艺品的，号称是纯铜制品，不过陈言又不傻的。
一百八的价格，买纯铜的罗盘？想桃子呢。
不过材质什么的无所谓了，罗盘这玩意儿不过是计算方位的，刻度准确就好了。
他是一个刚刚修炼奇术才入门的小萌新。
如今掌握的法术不过四个。
基本功法《天地元气搬运术》。
百搭功法《气运周数》算法，算是基本功之一。
然后就是《开天眼》和《截运术》这两个法术了——在册子里，都是垫底的存在。
法器是不可能有的，虽然鉴物篇里有不少制造法器的做法和材料说明。
但陈言看了几次后就暂时放弃了。
那些材料，凡是自己能看得懂的属于世俗里能买到的——自己卡里那一百万根本不够。
而那些自己都看不懂名字的材料，显然就不是那么容易找到的。
没有法器，那么布阵就只能也找那种门槛低的了。

那种可以攻可防，还自带杀伐或者陷敌功能的法阵，想都别想。
陈言只能挑选一些辅助阵法来尝试入门。
他这两天在研究一个册子里写的聚灵阵。
吸引陈言的原因是：聚灵阵这个东西，弹性大，门槛低，上限高。
要是材料充沛，元气雄厚的话，顶级的聚灵阵可以给你布置处一个人间仙境来。
如果材料不够的话……
山寨版，穷人版，有很多世俗材料也能凑合替代——不过功效也就同样很山寨了。
不过陈言倒是不介意，毕竟，先以练手为主要目标。
聚灵阵，效果可以提升一定范围内的天地元气的循环聚集。
在这个阵法范围内修炼天地元气搬运法，可以提升效率。
至于效果么……看布阵材料的品级了。
高级的材料陈言暂时弄不起，就从简单的先开始。
他去石料城里买了一块最普通的长条青石——用来替代普通版材料里的一种叫做【五色玉璧】的东西。
话说什么五色玉璧，陈言连听都没听说过。
青石条可就便宜多了，去了一趟装修建材的石料场，让人运了几块送到别墅院子里。
content_en:
Chapter 12 [Is it a treasure? 】
Chen Yan was studying his yard, walking with strange steps under his feet and mumbling words, from the Qimen number method, to the calculation of Tiangang and Disha, and then to the Bagua directions.
"Qian, Kun, Li, Kan, Zhen, Xun, Gen, Dui..."
Chen Yan was walking around the yard, holding a compass in his hand.
Well, the compass was bought, not a magic weapon that I made myself.
A certain treasure has it.
The one in Chen Yan's hand costs more than 180 yuan with free shipping.
The merchant sells handicrafts, claiming to be pure copper products, but Chen Yan is not stupid.
A hundred and eighty dollars to buy a pure copper compass? I miss peaches.
But the material doesn't matter. The compass is just for calculating directions, as long as the scale is accurate.
He is a newbie who has just started practicing thaumaturgy.
There are only four spells he has mastered now.
The basic skill "Transportation Technique of Heaven and Earth Energy".
The algorithm of the versatile exercise "Qi Luck Week Number" can be regarded as one of the basic skills.
Then there are the two spells "Opening the Sky Eye" and "Intercepting Luck" - they are both at the bottom of the book.
It is impossible to have a magic weapon, although there are many instructions on how to make a magic weapon and materials in the Appraisal Chapter.
But Chen Yan gave up temporarily after watching it a few times.
Those materials that I can understand are those that can be purchased in the world - the one million in my card is simply not enough.
And those materials whose names you don't understand are obviously not so easy to find.
If there is no magical weapon, then the only way to set up the formation is to find something with a low threshold.
Don't even think about that kind of magic circle that can attack and defend, and also has the function of killing or trapping enemies.
Chen Yan could only choose some auxiliary formations to try to get started.
He has been studying the spirit gathering formation written in a book these past two days.
The reason that attracts Chen Yan is: the Spirit Gathering Array has great flexibility, low threshold and high upper limit.
If you have enough materials and strong vitality, a top-notch spirit gathering array can create a fairyland on earth for you.
If the materials are not enough...
The copycat version, the poor man's version, there are many secular materials that can be substituted - but the effect is also very copycat.
But Chen Yan didn't mind. After all, his main goal was to practice his skills first.
The effect of the Spirit Gathering Array can enhance the cyclic gathering of the vitality of heaven and earth within a certain range.
Practicing the heaven and earth energy transfer method within the scope of this formation can improve efficiency.
As for the effect...it depends on the grade of the formation materials.
I can't afford advanced material presentations at the moment, so I'll start with the simple ones.
He went to the stone city and bought a piece of the most common long bluestone - used to replace something called [five-color jade] in the ordinary material.
Talking about five-color jade, Chen Yan had never even heard of it.
Bluestone strips were much cheaper. I went to the stone yard for building materials and had a few pieces transported to the villa yard.
